verdict.rationale: Dover documents interview feedback forms that can be assigned per interview stage so every interviewer scores candidates the same way, which gives per-stage structure and consistency across candidates. The evidence does not show focus areas assigned per interviewer, what attributes or rating scales a form contains, or any side-by-side scorecard comparison. missing for 10: per-interviewer focused rubrics/attribute assignment, documented attribute and rating-scale definitions, cross-candidate scorecard comparison view, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews are scored on structured scorecards — defined attributes per stage, focused rubrics per interviewer, comparable across candidates

citations.quote: Create a form once, assign it to an interview stage, and every interviewer scores candidates the same way.
Each stage can have its own interviewers, duration, meeting type, email templates, and feedback form.
It shows the candidate's details, their resume, and the feedback form assigned to the interview stage.
Dover AI Notetaker joins your interviews, records and transcribes them, and fills in your interview feedback form with notes.
